acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce the second-boundary failure (for example with an injected clock or -count=50 under load) or document why it cannot be reproduced.
Fix the test to use a fixed or monotonic clock so recordedAt never precedes the head receipt, or fix the code if the ordering is a real defect.
Or fold the evidence into V1-0849 and archive this ticket with that reason.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the beamfall/corvint#653 lane (branch claude/gh653, base 79536edd, head b406fe36; go1.27.1, darwin arm64).

Suspected, not confirmed: TestCALV0116_WriterRouteTamperAtFastStages in internal/tasks/store fails intermittently, in a different subtest each time, because the tampered record's `recordedAt` lands one second before the head receipt's. It passed 3/3 at the lane head and 2/2 at the base, so it is not caused by that change; it looks like a wall-clock second-boundary race in the test, worse under host load (load average 42-55). Related umbrella: V1-0849 (load- and timing-sensitive test failures). Expected: the test passes deterministically, or its failure names a real defect.

completion.reason: Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#667 (planted receipt clock flake), merged to main by auto-merge as 0c94c66c891c1a56b1f06b17953ca4e665151501. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0952-planted-receipt-clock.md at that commit (digest is its sha256), recording the recordedAt re-sample in internal/tasks/store/mutate.go, the wall-clock planted subtests, and the Codex review. vet, the full store and CLI packages and the doc gates passed; the CEM was bound, checked and sealed (seal head 80013f34) before merge. NOT_RUN: make gate. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.
